title: 第25章 要是这样三长老你不得投胎十八次了第26章 不会是坏事暴露想跑吧
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 听了四长老的话，大长老等人一愣，随即点点头。
大长老道：“是我太着急了，我会和屿白说的。”
进入混沌灵域的名额是由宗门分配的，以往让蒋凤熙等人去也是因为他们最有资格，可这并不代表去混沌灵域的只能是他们几个。
大长老说的是‘我会跟屿白说的’而不是‘我会和屿白商量’，可见他已经下定了决心要把名额给林筱了。
大长老在天衍宗是有绝对的话语权的，哪怕三长老和五长老仍有不满也只能闭嘴了。
就在众人以为林筱进混沌灵域已经是板上钉钉的事的时候，一直没有插嘴机会的林筱却开口了，“我不去。”
大长老发现林筱总有办法一句话让他心肌梗塞，气不打一处来。
这死丫头，他好不容易给她争取来资格了，她说什么？她不去？
林筱道，“这个资格该是谁的就是谁的，我不会抢别人的东西，就算不进这个混沌灵域，我一样可以提升修为。”
大长老解释：“林筱，你误会了，这个名额不是固定的，你没有抢屿白的名额，事实上，现在你比他更需要这个名额。”
“不用。”
林筱对进秘境没兴趣，苦修闭关是那些根骨悟性好的人提升修为的方式，林筱清楚，对她来说，在生死之磨炼才是她修炼的主道！
大长老捂住心脏，他感觉他有些气短。
“不必多言，相对于进混沌灵域，我更关心一件事。”
仿佛不是放弃了一个天大的机遇，而是扔了一张纸一样，林筱表现的云淡风轻，毫不在意。
“我去灵竹林做任务，碰见玄天剑宗的殷裴正在追杀天衍宗弟子。”
“那个殷裴污蔑是我让他动的手，现在我怀疑宗内有人勾结殷裴，故意陷害我。”
一波未平一波又起，林筱这句话相当于又往大殿中扔了个炸弹，炸的大长老几人心神懵逼，随即怒从心来！
都顾不上跟林筱说混沌灵域的事了，有人勾结外宗弟子残害同门，这事显然更重要，更严重一点。
大长老看向魏明几人：“你们几人，林筱说的是真的吗？”
魏明如实道：“大长老，弟子本接了一个玄品高阶任务，眼看任务完成，那殷裴突然杀出，二话不说把我和吴应几位师弟打成重伤。”
“后来他跟弟子说，是有人让他来杀弟子，那个人就是林筱大师姐，可不料大师姐正好在场，这个谎言便不攻自破了。”
听到魏明的话，大长老更是怒不可遏，他们天衍宗向来团结，居然出了这么一个勾结外宗的败类，不可原谅！
“林筱，你可知道那人是谁？”
林筱顿了顿：“弟子确实有一人怀疑。”
“洛云卿！”
她话音一落，三长老第一个跳出来，他是洛云卿的师父，洛云卿从没有跟他说过她认识玄天剑宗的殷裴，所以他断定林筱是在污蔑洛云卿。
“胡言乱语！
林筱，云卿是前段时间做了一些错事，可她已经受到惩罚了，你何必一再揪着云卿不放？你心胸狭隘，没有肚量，你不配当一个师姐！”
林筱都习惯三长老像只疯狗一样对着她肆意狂吠了，她很平淡道：“是不是，把洛云卿喊来一问便知。”
“喊就喊！”
三长老确定林筱是在污蔑洛云卿，刚刚被林筱怼，他仿佛看到了反击的机会，“来人，去把云卿叫来！”
“如果不是云卿做的，林筱，你随意污蔑宗内同门，和那殷裴有何区别？”
林筱轻嗤：“区别大了，我可没有杀害同门，若是被我说两句话就会死，三长老你应该已经投胎十八次了吧。”
三长老知道林筱说话厉害，但这回他胜券在握，“哼，你也就嘴皮子厉害了。”
“哪里哪里，和三长老您随意污蔑，血口喷人，满嘴喷粪对比起来，我还是太嫩了。”
林筱和三长老又互怼了起来，大长老都无奈了，他阻止不了两人，干脆侧开头不理会任由他俩明争暗斗，互相较劲了。
这时，殿外传来一道轻笑。
众人扭头，一男一女并肩走进大殿，正是岳子舒和温以宁。
那声轻笑就是岳子舒发出的，他发现他回来后很喜欢听林筱怼人，嘴又快又毒又狠，听的他心里莫名很爽。

content_en:
After hearing what the fourth elder said, the first elder and others were stunned, then nodded.
The great elder said: "I am too anxious, I will tell Yu Bai."
The places to enter the Chaos Spirit Realm are allocated by the sect. In the past, Jiang Fengxi and others were allowed to go because they were the most qualified, but this does not mean that only a few of them can go to the Chaos Spirit Realm.
The great elder said 'I will talk to Yu Bai' instead of 'I will discuss it with Yu Bai', which shows that he has made up his mind to give the quota to Lin Xiao.
The Great Elder has the absolute right to speak in Tianyan Sect. Even if the Third Elder and the Fifth Elder are still dissatisfied, they can only shut up.
Just when everyone thought it was certain that Lin Xiao would enter the Chaos Spiritual Realm, Lin Xiao, who had never had a chance to intervene, said, "I won't go."
The elder found out that Lin Xiao always had a way of giving him a myocardial infarction with just one sentence, which made him very angry.
This damn girl, he finally got her qualifications, what did she say? She won't go?
Lin Xiao said, "This qualification belongs to whoever it is. I will not steal other people's things. Even if I don't enter this chaotic spiritual realm, I can still improve my cultivation."
The Great Elder explained: "Lin Xiao, you misunderstood. This quota is not fixed. You did not grab Yu Bai's quota. In fact, you need this quota more than him now."
"No need."
Lin Xiao is not interested in entering the secret realm. Ascetic cultivation and retreat are ways for those with good understanding to improve their cultivation. Lin Xiao knows that for her, training in life and death is the main way of her cultivation!
"You!"
The great elder covered his heart. He felt a little short of breath.
"Needless to say, I am more concerned about one thing than entering the Chaos Spirit Realm."
As if he was throwing away a piece of paper instead of giving up a huge opportunity, Lin Xiao acted calmly and didn't care.
"I went to Lingzhu Forest to do a mission, and I met Yin Pei from the Xuantian Sword Sect who was chasing the disciples of the Tianyan Sect."
"I asked him to slander Yin Pei. Now I suspect that someone in the sect colluded with Yin Pei and deliberately framed me."
Lin Xiao's words were like throwing another bomb into the hall. The explosion made the elders confused and angry!
He didn't even bother to tell Lin Xiao about the Chaos Spiritual Realm. Someone colluded with the disciples from outside the sect to harm their fellow disciples. This matter was obviously more important and serious.
The great elder looked at Wei Ming and others: "You guys, is what Lin Xiao said true?"
Wei Ming said matter-of-factly: "Great Elder, this disciple accepted a high-level Xuanpin mission. Just as the mission was completed, Yin Pei suddenly came out and seriously injured myself and Wu Ying and several other juniors without saying a word."
"Later, he told his disciple that someone asked him to kill him, and that person was Senior Sister Lin Xiao. Unexpectedly, Senior Sister happened to be present, and this lie was self-defeating."
Hearing Wei Ming's words, the Great Elder was even more furious. Their Tianyan Sect had always been united, but there was such a scum who colluded with other sects. It was unforgivable!
"Lin Xiao, do you know who that person is?"
Lin Xiao paused: "There is indeed one disciple who is suspicious."
"Who?"
"Luo Yunqing!"
As soon as she finished speaking, the third elder jumped out first. He was Luo Yunqing's master. Luo Yunqing had never told him that she knew Yin Pei from Xuantian Sword Sect, so he concluded that Lin Xiao was slandering Luo Yunqing.
“Nonsense!
Lin Xiao, Yun Qing did something wrong some time ago, but she has already been punished. Why do you keep holding on to Yun Qing? You are narrow-minded and have no tolerance. You are not worthy of being a senior sister! "
Lin Xiao was used to the third elder barking at her like a mad dog. She said calmly: "Really, just call Luo Yunqing and ask."
"Just shout!"
The third elder was sure that Lin Xiao was slandering Luo Yunqing. He had just been attacked by Lin Xiao, and he seemed to have seen an opportunity to fight back, "Come on, call Yun Qing!"
"If it wasn't Yun Qing who did it, Lin Xiao, how are you different from Yin Pei if you slander your fellow sect members at will?"
Lin Xiao sneered lightly: "The difference is big. I didn't kill any of my fellow disciples. If you say a few words to me, you will die. Third Elder, you should have been reincarnated eighteen times."
The third elder knew that Lin Xiao was a good talker, but this time he was sure of winning, "Humph, you are just a good talker."
"No, compared to Third Elder, who slanders you at will, spits blood, and spits feces from your mouth, I am still too young."
Lin Xiao and the third elder started fighting each other again, and the elder was helpless. He couldn't stop the two of them, so he simply ignored them and allowed them to fight openly and secretly, competing with each other.
At this time, a chuckle came from outside the hall.
"Heh~"
Everyone turned around, and a man and a woman walked into the hall side by side. It was Yue Zishu and Wen Yining.
That chuckle was made by Yue Zishu. He found that after he came back, he liked to listen to Lin Xiao yelling at people, fast, vicious and cruel, which made him feel inexplicably happy.
